author: ogajoiberico
quote:
The only good thing about this game are the graphics. Everything else is tremendously disappointing and the ‘soul’ of GTA has been removed;
- Jason and Lucia are boring characters, not worthy of leading a GTA game
- Lucia is extremely annoying and you feel like you’re just playing a game to please her / do chores for her
- missions are quite boring. No engaging missions like the ones in previous GTA
- you cant even rob any car you want

Clearly, Rockstar / TakeTwo are headed in the entirely wrong direction and something drastic changed since GTA 5, San Andreas and other games. I’m willing to bet a significant part of the team has changed because this game is awful
